execution: Prior-session signals, next-session open; open reward/risk rechecked; fixed stop/target, stop first on ambiguous bars, 20-session maximum hold; max 10 equal-equity slots; cash uninvested earns zero.

cost_model.applied_to: entry and exit notional; configured assumptions, not broker quote

holdout_note: Chronological 70/30 descriptive split; no optimization, no claim of independent out-of-sample validation.
limitations: Current 254-company snapshot creates survivorship bias; delisted equities absent.
Only about 520 calendar days available; short history, few trades and one market regime can be inconclusive.
Vendor retrospectively adjusted prices are not point-in-time corporate-action snapshots.
Quarantined bars cannot generate signals, execute orders or value exits; missing position marks are carried and counted.
TASI comparison uses observed close-to-close values over identical evaluation dates; stocks enter at next open.
No tax, spread beyond assumed slippage, liquidity capacity or dividend cash-flow model; adjusted closes embed vendor adjustments.
No reconstruction of how old source corrections were known in real time.
